touches.text: Owns the inspectors and gates (draft, moving from standalone): build_inspector, plan_inspector, ticket_inspector, corrosion, exemptions, rehearsal, determinism, import_sieve, and the tester (11; Q#33, Akien 2026-10-29). (Not diagnostic_inspector: it is base's, 17.3.) The code pipeline's inspectors and gates move to CodeMother; any that are not about code (if such existed) would not. (Q#31, Akien 2026-10-27)
TESTER MACHINE, CodeMother's (was the tester device, cairn/devices/tester/)
COMMANDS: cairn test (--hollow, --seal, --exec, …) → cairn codemother test, the CLI a client of her verb
Logging and diagnostics. These can be in different files, mixed in together.

open_questions.text: `commit` and `cross` are verbs here: is moving a ticket across its workflow CodeMother's job (she owns the workflows), or the ticket's (it owns its refusals, 3.3.1.5)?
